g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.physics.flow.boundary_conditions.CauchyBC
Cauchy flow boundary condition.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.boundary_conditions.DirichletBC
Dirichlet flow boundary condition.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.boundary_conditions.FlowBoundaryForcingConstantConfig
Constant head forcing applied to every stress period.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.boundary_conditions.FlowBoundaryForcingCsvConfig
CSV-backed boundary forcing resolved at runtime against simulation.time.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.boundary_conditions.RobinBC
Robin flow boundary condition.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.flow_config.FlowConfig
Flow-process configuration.
Parameters are declared in `param_list` (ordered list of ids), and parameter payloads are stored in `param`. The 13 flat ``runtime_*``/``vi_*``/``ts_vi_*`` Boussinesq knobs are declared on :class:`FlowRuntimeFields` and grouped together by the :attr:`runtime` property as a :class:`FlowRuntimeConfig` view.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.flow_param_config.FlowParam
Flow parameter payload using native field-param sections.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowInitialConditions
Container for flow initial conditions stored in process runtime.
Keeping one explicit container (instead of bare values) allows the process API to remain extensible when adding future IC variables.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.container.FlowSinksSourcesConfig
Top-level container for all sink/source elements of the flow process.
Maps directly to the ``[flow.sinks_sources]`` TOML section. All fields are optional so that a minimal ``FlowSinksSourcesConfig()`` (no wells, no recharge, no etp) is always valid and represents a passive model.
Fields ------ wells : dict[str, FlowWellConfig] Pumping/injection wells keyed by a user-defined string id. recharge : FlowRechargeConfig | None Diffuse recharge configuration. ``None`` means no recharge. etp : FlowEtpConfig | None Diffuse evapotranspiration configuration. ``None`` means no EVT package is built.

hydromodpy.spatial.field.core._field_param_sections.FieldHeterogeneousSection
Schema for heterogeneous `[field]` payloads.

hydromodpy.spatial.field.core._field_param_sections.FieldHomogeneousSection
Schema for homogeneous `[field]` payloads.

hydromodpy.spatial.field.core._field_param_sections.FieldVerticalProfileSection
Schema for `[field_vertical_profile]`.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowICBottom
Initialize head at the bottom surface (empty aquifer).

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowICCustom
Initialize head with one explicit numeric value.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowICSteadyState
Initialize a transient run from a same-solver steady solve.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowICTop
Initialize head at the top surface (full aquifer).

hydromodpy.physics.flow.initial_conditions.FlowICTopOffset
Initialize head at the top surface minus a vertical offset `value`.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.etp.FlowEtpConfig
Typed payload for diffuse evapotranspiration over the model domain.
Drives the MODFLOW EVT package. Conceptually parallel to :class:`FlowRechargeConfig`: scalar / list / mapping / runtime-series payloads are accepted and converted to SI ``m/s`` at runtime via ``apply_etp_load_result_to_flow``. The actual conversion to a stress-period dictionary is handled by :class:`FlowToModflowAdapter._build_etp_payload`. This is the unique entry point for the EVT package.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.recharge.FlowRechargeConfig
Typed payload for diffuse recharge over the model domain.
Recharge drives the MODFLOW RCH package. The conversion to MODFLOW stress-period dictionaries is handled by ``FlowToModflowAdapter._build_recharge_payload``. Negative values can be routed to EVT when ``negative_to_evt`` is enabled.
Attributes ---------- values : Recharge payload. Accepted forms:
- **scalar** ``float``: uniform rate applied to every stress period, - **list / numpy array**: one value per stress period (length must match ``nper``), - **mapping** ``{period_index: value}``: explicit per-period assignment, - **runtime series** (pandas-like object with ``.iloc``): used when recharge is computed dynamically (e.g. from PyHELP output).
first_clim : str | float Policy for stress-period 0 when ``values`` is a sequence. MODFLOW steady-state warm-up periods often need a representative rate that differs from the first raw time step. Options:
- ``"mean"``: arithmetic mean of the entire series (default), - ``"first"``: first value of the series, - *numeric*: explicit scalar.
units : str Physical units of ``values``. The flow runtime converts the payload to SI ``m/s`` when the process is built.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellConfig
Typed payload for one pumping or injection well.
A well is defined by its location (``location``) and its flux schedule over time (``flux``). ``location`` is a discriminated union with three variants: ``cell`` for direct ``[lay, row, col]`` indexing, ``absolute_xy`` for projected coordinates, or ``relative_xy`` for normalized horizontal coordinates. ``flux`` follows the MODFLOW sign convention: negative = pumping, positive = injection. ``flux`` may be a scalar (constant rate) or a list with one value per stress period.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellForcingConstantConfig
One constant well-rate forcing applied to every stress period.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellForcingCsvConfig
CSV-backed well forcing resolved at runtime against simulation.time.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellLocationAbsoluteXY
Projected ``(x, y)`` coordinates in solver units.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellLocationCell
Direct ``[lay, row, col]`` addressing on a structured solver grid.

hydromodpy.physics.flow.sinks_sources.wells.FlowWellLocationRelativeXY
Normalized ``(x_rel, y_rel)`` in ``[0, 1]`` over the domain extent.
